name: Spirit and Katana
source:
Haru, a hero from the Town of Relina, travels to Celedain to join the Guild of Heroes!
When he meets the Guild of Heroes, they welcome him with a courageous spirit!
Now, he must use his skills as a hero along with his katana to forge a bright future for the land!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1741620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
来自雷利纳镇的勇者Haru，前往塞勒丹，准备加入勇者公会！
公会以满腔勇气与热情欢迎他的到来！
如今，他必须凭借勇者的本领与手中的武士刀，为这片土地开创光明的未来！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1741620/]Steam[/url]]
